हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/HnHCwE
show.description: Natasha makes a dark deal with a witch, sacrificing her own life so her husband Chirag’s broken fate can change. As Chirag becomes powerful and wealthy, he turns cold, divorces Natasha, and chooses his past love, never knowing the price she paid. Between betrayal, supernatural fate, and a mother’s silent sacrifice, this emotional tale asks: will his remorse come only after her death?
